solutionSql:
SELECT (booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS booking_day,
       COUNT(*)::integer AS bookings
FROM shipments
GROUP BY (booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY booking_day;
notes: January 31 holds exactly two bookings (shipments 1 and 2), which are out of sequence with the rest of the table, so the day qualifies under the at-least-two rule. The UTC conversion is written explicitly, so the result does not depend on the session time zone.
